rule: D7: expectations before observation. The D23 classes are the literal reading of each Program golden's source (docs/COMPILER-CAMPAIGN.md D23, vm/SPEC.md sections 7 and 8), predicted from a literal reading of each source before the classifier was first run, and recorded here after it agreed. The halting-relation counts were observed on the first complete lockstep run and then frozen, so that a VM or model that stops deviating (CORE.md choice 8 settled) fails the gate until the relation is deleted.

d23.reading: Under D23 an IO request is a value performed only where the Program's Top loop receives it. Eager and D23 give one trace exactly when every Action applied to a continuation is applied with only Scope and Call frames between it and Top: such a frame returns a value unread, so the request reaches Top. Each golden Program below is a chain of IO.bind and IO.print in tail position; its bind lambdas apply the next action in tail position, so each effect meets Top through Scope and Call frames.

pending: vm-rc: the VM does not reclaim (vm/CORE.md choice 1), the model does (SPEC section 5). rc, free lists and unreachable memory are outside the comparison until vm-rc; `exact` strength is implemented and controlled, and turns on for VM against model when the VM reclaims.

D23 (in flight on campaign/vm-spec, then vm-model and vm-core): IO requests become values performed at the Program's Top loop. Both machines here perform at application (the eager reading), so they agree with each other; a Program with an effect that is not on the spine is marked pending-D23 by the classifier and its expected observation changes with D23.

the image encoder (src/image.bend, increment `image`): the frozen suites of the repository have no images, so the value differential covers vm-spec's frozen fixtures, the goldens and their Book invocations.
vm-prims: sha256-64k needs the reserved prims 39 and 40 (U32.or, U32.xor).
vm-rc: peano, list-fold and deep-recursion allocate beyond a bump arena of 4 GiB (vm/bench/README.md), so their speed ratios cannot be measured before reclamation.
